title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol against GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol
summary: OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Astra is 20% cheaper than GPT-6 Astra, scores 6.2 points higher and uses 22% fewer output tokens, and that GPT-6.2 Sol scores 5.3 points above GPT-6.1 Sol at the same price. OpenAI's quality figures come from its own GDPval v2 evaluation, so independent indexes are used as proxies.

claims.text: GPT-6.2 Astra is 20% cheaper than GPT-6 Astra

ref.note: Intelligence Index v5.0.1 at max. On the Vals Index, cost per test fell from $21.28 to $10.68.

claims.text: GPT-6.2 Astra uses 22% fewer output tokens than GPT-6 Astra
claims.scopeNote: OpenAI measured this on GDPval v2. This uses output tokens across the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.

ref.unit: million output tokens across the index

claims.text: The same token saving, checked at max reasoning
claims.scopeNote: OpenAI did not say which setting. At max, GPT-6.2 Astra writes more tokens, not fewer.

ref.unit: million output tokens across the index

claims.text: GPT-6.2 Astra scores 6.2 points higher than GPT-6 Astra
claims.scopeNote: OpenAI's figure is on GDPval v2; the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index is the independent proxy.

ref.note: Both at max. The Vals Index shows +2.7 points (63.55% → 66.27%).

claims.text: GPT-6.2 Sol scores 5.3 points higher than GPT-6.1 Sol
claims.scopeNote: OpenAI's figure is on GDPval v2; the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index is the independent proxy.

ref.note: Both at max. The Vals Index shows +2.8 points (62.26% → 65.07%).

observations.text: GPT-6.2 Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's prices, and its cost per index task at max fell from $1.27 to $1.01.
GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol are now marked deprecated by Artificial Analysis but are still benchmarked.

livePack.note: Starter tasks plus multi-step efficiency tasks.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
